$comment: Copy this file outside the repo and edit it. Configs hold env-var NAMES only, never keys. Prices are USD per million tokens; leave pricing out when unknown and receipts record usdEstimate: null. Model ids and base URLs here are examples to replace with what you actually run. type "cli" runs an official CLI on your own subscription (ADR-006): no API keys (API-key env vars are stripped from the child unless keepApiKeyEnv is true), the prompt goes on stdin or as one argv element (promptVia: "arg"), never through a shell, and receipts record usdEstimate: null with pricingSource: "subscription". Check the flags against the CLI version you have installed.

systems.$comment: Claude Code on your Claude subscription. `claude -p` reads the prompt from stdin when no prompt argument is given.
OpenAI Codex CLI on your ChatGPT subscription. The trailing `-` makes `codex exec` read the prompt from stdin.
Gemini CLI on your Google account. `-p` takes the prompt as its value, so promptVia is "arg": the prompt is passed as one argv element right after -p.
